validity_findings.finding: Frozen spec.json hypothesis and prereg.md Section 7 describe Fix3 as 'minimum prefix length threshold of 12 characters after scheme+authority delimiter' (and Section 8 justification) with example len(path_part) <3. Implemented src/spider/kernel.py _is_protocol_only_prefix (sha 8aed6377) uses pure structural check: split '://', then '/' not in rest => True (protocol-only). No length threshold 12 is applied. Functional equivalence holds for gated PROTOCOL_ONLY case (https:// -> True), disclosed in result.json validity_notes[1] and report.md Section 3, but frozen 12-char wording was not executed as written.
